decisions.F1: PM adds workspace dependency entries and architecture allowlist/graph proof for unisphere-loader-query and unisphere-output-query. No fake runtime crates; actual implementations remain their allocated lanes.
decisions.F2: All six datasets declare native_id/harness/adapter/availability with the SAME existing sensitivity and predicate conventions. NativeId stays sensitive; default metadata projections stay safe.
decisions.F3: Keep behavior tests, no source-text checks or tautological mutation of objects the digest never receives. A known fixed independently calculated digest vector can defend closed preimage/repeated encoding; assert request option changes alter query binding while an actual shared view produces the same source digest. Add true invalid-input and selection boundary cases.
decisions.F4: Replace unused JSON design bytes with a real typed Rust fixture: pub fn shared_query_fixture() -> Vec<InspectedSource> in testkit/src/query.rs. Preserve representative two-source native observations, initiating user vs tool-response facts, supported clocks and undated/partial source. Remove SHARED_QUERY_FIXTURE and dead shared-v1.json; do NOT add Serialize/Deserialize to raw production evidence just for fixtures. Exercise the fixture via native validation/provenance rejection in testkit library tests and actual external SDK consumer; PM adjusts freeze/read references and baseline check to include testkit.
decisions.F5: Keep C10 scalar RFC3339 wire timestamps. Add TimestampBasis::SuppliedUnknown (wire supplied_unknown), use it in BOTH Timestamp Deserialize and projected_value_from_json. No input string may fabricate Native. Add FormatLoss::TimestampBasis (wire timestamp_basis) to formats that cannot preserve the basis, including Json/Jsonl for timestamp-bearing datasets; lossy must agree with losses. PM explicitly documents this field-level loss; no native timestamp instant/duration/history fabrication. Native adapters still pass their observed basis explicitly. Compare time bounds by instant, not basis tie-break.
decisions.F6: QueryRequest validation errors must recover against self.dataset when dataset context is known. Dataset-independent Timestamp/range/Has/SourceSelection errors use one new neutral RecoveryAction::ReadQueryHelp; never name an unrelated dataset. Preserve typed causes and safe fixed messages. QueryRequest::validate public signature stays unchanged; lower-level signatures preferably unchanged. Core coder publishes any necessary exact helper/API change to proof coder before consumption.
decisions.F7: Sources/messages/events have no Stats operation: set grouping_fields empty. Do not add new Stats support.
decisions.F8: Timestamp PartialEq/Eq/PartialOrd/Ord compare unix_nanos only. Basis remains metadata and cannot perturb equal-instant filtering, row sorting, cursor positions, or round-trip value equality.

status: Core F2/F5/F6/F7 candidate integrated; F8 and proof pending; no fresh acceptance
